concepts.label: session
concepts.definition: One agent working session: a transcript, its working directory and branch.

concepts.label: prompt
concepts.definition: One request a user submitted to the agent within a session.

concepts.label: decision
concepts.definition: A choice the user and the agent settled on: an approach taken, a design fixed, an option rejected.

concepts.label: file
concepts.definition: A file in the working directory, named by the path a tool call addressed it with.

concepts.label: tool
concepts.definition: A tool the agent may call, named as the transcript names it.

predicates.label: asked_in
predicates.definition: The prompt was asked in the session.

predicates.label: touched
predicates.definition: The tool read or searched the file without changing it.

predicates.label: changed
predicates.definition: The tool wrote to the file, changing its content.

predicates.label: decided_in
predicates.definition: The decision was decided in the session.

predicates.label: decision_status
predicates.definition: The current status of the decision; a later status supersedes the earlier one.
